descriptions.introduction: Get started with Hyvor Post, a privacy-first newsletter platform that sends email newsletters without tracking subscribers. Learn the basics and sign up.
descriptions.signupForm: Embed the Hyvor Post newsletter signup form on your website. Double opt-in by default, customizable styling, multiple lists, and form attributes.
descriptions.emailDesign: Customize your newsletter email design in Hyvor Post. Edit the default email template or build custom templates to match your brand.
descriptions.import: Import subscribers into Hyvor Post from a CSV file. Migrate your newsletter subscribers from another email service with field mapping.
descriptions.apiConsole: Automate newsletter tasks with the Hyvor Post Console API. Authenticate with an API key to manage subscribers, lists, and issues over HTTP.
